contracts_rationale: Test-hygiene and build-dependency mission: no API, event or schema interface is added or changed.
friendly_name: Test-suite tidy: keep Mockito at Spring Boot's version, pin refusal codes
purpose_context: The 2026-11-03 test suite assessment found Mockito declared and attached as a Java agent to every test JVM though no test uses it (R7, #373), and 15 tests that accept any CharterRefusal regardless of its code (R3, #369). Spring Boot's test starter brings Mockito anyway, so the operator ruled to keep it: this tidy-first mission aligns its version to the one Spring Boot manages and records why it stays, then strengthens those 15 checks in place so a wrong refusal code fails a test.
purpose_tldr: Keep Mockito at the version Spring Boot manages, with the reason recorded, and pin the refusal code on 15 type-only refusal assertions.
